description: This file defines the PersonVoidHandler class which handles voiding (deactivating) Person objects by setting relevant void/voided attributes and retiring associated User accounts within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: PersonVoidHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the voiding process for Person objects, including setting void attributes and retiring associated User accounts.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Sets all personVoid* attributes to indicate that the Person has been voided; also retires associated User accounts if applicable.
